purpose: One coherent installer flow, with opaque left artwork and dark glass right pane.

measurementContext.requiredDiskSpace: Must be calculated by the installer, including overhead; payload is not the total disk-space requirement.

concepts.title: 1 · Welcome
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one full high-fidelity WINDOWS INSTALLER screen in an internally consistent three-screen Forge Room wizard. Reference image: the user's selected Signature Glass visual design. Preserve the reference's overall premium minimal black glass-window styling, logo, architectural room illustration, installer window proportions, and subdued red accent. This is a visual mockup, not code. One complete front-facing 800x540 logical-pixel window, rendered sharply with readable UI text, all edges visible, small exterior margins, no collage and no perspective.
CRITICAL requested change: LEFT BRAND ART PANEL MUST BE COMPLETELY OPAQUE. A solid neutral #121314 panel occupying 27% width, absolutely NO transparency, no background blur bleeding through it, no exterior red light shining through the panel. Keep the entire architectural room artwork on that left panel crisp: fine opaque gray room-outline geometry and the same restrained small red-lit doorway; small ring-plus mark and stacked FORGE ROOM wordmark above. It should look like a flat opaque printed artwork panel. SMALL metadata at its bottom '0.109.0-alpha.1 · Windows x64'.
Only the RIGHT content pane and top title bar have restrained smoky dark Acrylic glass. Tint #121314 neutral black, subtle realistic translucency and blur visible only at edges and blank content areas, near-white text, gray secondary text; solid dark form controls. Whole-window faint 1px edge and subtle 10px rounded corners. Exterior backdrop softly blurred neutral charcoal room shapes and one muted-red detail, no purple/blue tints, no neon, no liquid glass distortion, no shiny decorative panels. The opaque left panel must clearly contrast in material with the frosted right side.
Use precisely the same brand rail arrangement and window dimensions across screens: title bar 'Forge Room Setup'; small logo, quiet native window controls; left panel width 27%; main content padding 36px; modest 26px heading; body text 14px; consistent bottom action area 58px high. Red #C74C45 only for enabled primary action. Gray tertiary actions no blue and NO UNDERLINES. No gigantic title, no dashboard, no feature card grid, no marketing slogans, no download meters. Form labels and small controls comfortable native desktop scale. Do not add made-up contributors or legal conditions.
SCREEN 1: WELCOME. Main heading 'Welcome to Forge Room'. Small subtitle 'Early Preview setup'. Two concise paragraphs: 'This wizard will install Forge Room on your computer.' and 'A native preview for opening, editing and saving text files.' A restrained small neutral information note reads 'This preview is unsigned. Some features are still in development.' Below it one small gray no-underline text action 'Preview notes'. Small system metadata 'Windows 11 · x64'. The right pane has generous calm space and a modest title, not a giant marketing hero. At bottom ONLY enabled red 'Continue' and quiet 'Cancel', aligned right. NO Back button on this first screen, NO license checkbox here, NO install-path control yet. The left artwork is completely opaque and crisp; glass right panel subtle and readable.

'Copyright (c) 2026 Forge Room contributors'

Under the reading area a clearly UNCHECKED 16px familiar checkbox labeled 'I accept the license agreement'. Helper small text 'Accept the agreement to continue.' Bottom actions 'Back', 'Continue', 'Cancel'; Continue MUST be disabled gray and have no red fill because the checkbox is unchecked. This is a real consent step with clear hierarchy. Fully opaque crisp left brand artwork remains fixed; no glass applied to the license reading surface.
